description:
Reid RB350 Mini 16" eBike | Mini electric bike
Compact, distinctive and built for fun, the RB350 Mini combines moto-inspired styling with powerful electric assistance for everyday adventures.
The Reid RB350 Mini is a compact electric bike designed for teenagers and adults looking for something a little different. With its sturdy steel frame, integrated bench seat and 16" wheels, it brings together distinctive styling and a practical setup for shorter journeys and leisure rides.
Wide 16 x 3.0" tyres and a stable wheelbase help provide a smooth, confident ride, while simple single-speed gearing keeps things easy and straightforward. There's no need to worry about changing gears, making it easy to hop on and enjoy the ride.
A 350W rear hub motor with 400W peak power and 40Nm of torque provides electric assistance up to 20mph. The integrated 36V 10.2Ah (367Wh) battery offers an approximate range of up to 40 miles (64km), depending on terrain and riding style, giving riders extra support for everyday trips and leisure rides.
Mechanical disc brakes provide dependable stopping power, while integrated front and rear LED lights help improve visibility. Front and rear mudguards and a kickstand add everyday practicality, making the RB350 Mini ready for a variety of rides.
Weighing approximately 25kg, the RB350 Mini combines a compact design with distinctive moto-inspired styling and easy electric assistance. It's a fun alternative to a conventional electric bike, with plenty of personality.
The RB350 Mini 16" eBike is ideal for:

Teenagers and adults, with a compact design and integrated bench seat

Shorter everyday journeys, with a 350W rear hub motor and 367Wh battery

Electric-assisted cruising, with assistance up to 20mph

Simple, easy riding, with straightforward single-speed gearing

A distinctive moto-inspired look, with a sturdy steel frame and wide tyres

Confident stopping, with mechanical disc brakes

Everyday practicality, with integrated LED lights, mudguards and a kickstand

Leisure rides, with an approximate range of up to 40 miles (64km), depending on riding conditions

Electric bike power, speed and throttle requirements vary between countries and may affect where and how this model can legally be used.
